tree.kind: verbatim copies of upstream files; copied, never installed as a distribution
tree.why: Hermes' provider layer is the practical route to integrations other than the Codex subscription: the per-provider sign-in modules, the provider registry, the model catalogs and the credential store all assume each other's presence.
tree.whitespace: byte-for-byte upstream copies. Whitespace linters must leave this tree alone (.gitattributes marks it -whitespace); normalising it would break the provenance.
tree.profiles_are_scanned_not_imported: plugins/model-providers/<name>/ holds one provider profile each (__init__.py + plugin.yaml). providers/__init__.py scans that directory relative to the package root, so an absent profile never raises: the provider silently loses its default model, aliases and capabilities while every import still succeeds. Copy that directory whenever the tree is captured; tests/test_vendor_tree.py guards it.

narrow_adapter.kind: narrow adaptation for the Codex subscription request path; it does not import the vendored tree

used_by: src/commahum/hermes_provider.py — provider_generator for the rewriting pipeline
